authority: Root investigator final pre-results protocol overrides this advisory contract
research_question: Does option-implied volatility term-structure shape add daily net economic decision value beyond price state and legacy VIX level/change?
model_family: Three regularized linear action-advantage heads with native net-log-wealth labels

decision_schedule.frequency: every eligible European close including monthly dates
decision_schedule.monthly_hold_semantics: HOLD skips the same-date scheduled rebalance and preserves actual units/cash
decision_schedule.candidate: single deterministic fresh basket from frozen DEDUP_DUAL_TREND_OPP on as-of data
decision_schedule.days_until_monthly_feature: strictly next monthly event after decision date; on a monthly decision this is approximately one month, not zero

states_per_eligible_date: frozen baseline actual snapshot before current instruction
synthetic all-cash state with the same starting NAV
anchor_training_bank.counterfactual_state_claim: All-cash state is hypothetical admissible state, not a free historical liquidation

label_contract.hold_initial: issue_initial=False; skip any same-session monthly instruction
label_contract.cash_or_fresh_initial: native intervention at next accepted execution
label_contract.continuation: frozen baseline monthly/native continuation only at j greater than decision session; no subsequent learned interventions
label_contract.transaction_cost: EUR1 plus0.0015 times executed order notional per order, native net orders
label_contract.mature: all required outcome/dependency timestamps strictly earlier than fit cutoff
label_contract.invalid_terminal_support: censor whole matched action comparison; report count and adverse valuation sensitivity
label_contract.known_native_nonfill: retain as economic outcome, not silently censor
label_contract.right_edge: pending, excluded from fit and mature-score summaries

feature_definitions.NM_L: log_return_L / (daily_vol63 * sqrt(L)); training/native volatility floor documented
feature_definitions.basket_history: trailing descriptive history of current actual weights/exposures; cash return zero; not a reconstructed funded past account
feature_definitions.breadth: positive-m63 share on frozen deduplicated/group-weighted universe

external_alignment.source: official Cboe raw daily historical CSVs with hashes
external_alignment.source_date: common date for VIX9D, VIX and VIX3M strictly earlier than European decision date
external_alignment.training_support: identical mature complete-label and external-source support across all nested arms
external_alignment.prediction_missing_block: fall back to valid lower-information nested model, recorded explicitly

fit_contract.term_residualization: training-only weighted OLS on price,state,legacy VIX and intercept; standardize resulting residuals
fit_contract.date_weight: total1 per date per head, divided across its valid state rows
fit_contract.label_interval_purge: only fully matured labels before current cutoff; no interval crossing validation forecast origin

uncertainty_buffer.method: coefficient prediction distribution from deterministic date-block bootstrap
uncertainty_buffer.interpretation: conservative heuristic, not calibrated90percent confidence or discovery inference

predict_contract.action_qualifies: predicted native net advantage greater than0 and bootstrap10th-percentile conditional-mean prediction greater than0
predict_contract.winner: largest qualifying lower bound; no-op/tie retains HOLD; stable action ordering thereafter
predict_contract.no_ready_head: frozen baseline fallback before policy readiness, as specified in executable protocol

frozen_diagnostic_matrix.failure_consequence: no promotion and no parameter/feature expansion
frozen_diagnostic_matrix.cost_stress_fit_semantics: must be stated explicitly in root executable protocol; do not silently mix baseline-cost training with claimed optimal double-cost decisions

mandatory_evaluation: full window with exact baseline warmup
per-head forecast MSE against mature mean and nested models
conditional selected-action economic value after costs
holding ages beyond monthly anchor support
not_claimed: formal statistical significance after OLC research reuse
cash selection alpha from positive entry returns alone
opening-auction executability from final daily volume
